description: Get exact install steps for one catalog tool in one agent: commands, config file path and snippet, one-click links for Cursor and VS Code, variables to fill in, recipe status and access level. Secrets are never included, only placeholders with the variable name. Agent is one of: claude-code, cursor, vscode, codex, gemini-cli, devin, cline, zoo-code, opencode, zed, sourcecraft, coddy, antigravity, kiro, claude-desktop, lm-studio (site aliases like vs-code, windsurf, roo-code, github-copilot, gemini also work). Section is skills, mcp, cli, plugins, workflows or prompts. After a successful install call report_install with the returned reportToken.
name: plan_install
